senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) strange thing, wonder, miracle. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 8 (ref. to Ex. XV, 11) עשה עמנו פ׳ וכ׳ he has done wonders for us, and he will do &c.; a. e.—Pl. פְּלָאִים, פְּלָאִין, פְּלָאוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 106:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CVI</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 136:4">Ps. CXXXVI, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Psalms 136:13">13</cite>; <cite ref="Psalms 136:25">25</cite>) <he>מה הפרנסה … בלא ניסין ובלא פ׳</he> as the world cannot exist without sustenance (which the Lord provides), so it cannot exist without (daily) signs and wonders.
<cite ref="Psalms 136:25">Ib.</cite> <he>ואינו יודע כמה פ׳ עשה וכ׳</he> ed. Bub. (ed. <he>מה פלאי</he>, corr. acc.) and man knows not how many miraculous salvations the Lord works for him.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:9">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 136:24">Ps. CXXXVI, 24</cite> sq.) <he>מה גאולה פ׳ אף פרנסה פ׳</he> as the redemption was miraculous, so man’s sustenance is miraculous.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 12:6">Ex. R. s. 12</cite>, end (expl. <he>אפילת</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 9:32">Ex. IX, 32</cite>) <he>פ׳ עשה הק״בה בהם</he> the Lord showed wonders by them.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:15">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>פלת</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 16:1">Num. XVI, 1</cite>) <he>שנעשו לו פ׳</he> wonderful things (delivery from destruction with Korah) happened to him (On); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:20">Num. R. s. 18</cite>; (Tanḥ. Kor. 10 <cite ref="N01060"><he>נפלאות</he></cite>). Midr. Till. To <cite ref="Psalms 119:18">Ps. CXIX, 18</cite> <he>פ׳ היא התורה</he> the Law is full of strange (obscure) things.

<cite ref="Psalms 119:129">Ib. 129</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 47">Yalk. Gen. 47</cite> <he>ומקרע בפלאות</he>, read: <he>בכִילָאוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="K00532"><he>כִּילָה</he></cite>.]
